subject: ist-f
title: (R)IST.F.------MT.INFO.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 392 (NYM-26). IST-F (isolated focus) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; MT-INFO (multi-information) is the partner. From the subject: INTL (intellectualism) and CULT-INFO-B (culture information basis). From INTL: CR-INFO-DY (circular information dynamics) and IST-S-ALGN (isolated systematic alignment). From CULT-INFO-B: DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) and INFO-F (information focus). From DYM-F: MTH (methodology). From MTH: P-FC (particular focus).
